messages:
Lina M: Quick heads-up: rolling out hotfix + new ff `fast-path-nn` tonight in the 23:00 UTC change window. This is model v3.1 with a perf patch. Rollout plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% by region (single-step regional ramp). Soak: 10m per step.

Carlos V: Are we keeping the v3 fallback pinned globally for the first 1% canary? Last hotfix caused example-rate regressions in APAC when we unpinned too early.

Lina M: We'll pin v2 globally until each region reaches 10%. Once a region is stable at 10% for 10m, we unpin for that region. Global pin remains optional per-region.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Lina M at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary: eu-west-2 (1%). Will post step completions and health checks in thread.

Priya S: Telemetry/gates: error_rate (5m), p95_latency (5m), 99th_token_latency (10m). Auto-fallback rule: if error_rate > 2% OR p95 > baseline + 200ms for 2 consecutive windows, immediately set ff pct to 0 for that region and re-pin to v2. Notify #eng-oncall and DM oncall.

oncall-bot: Alerting configured: DM to oncall, page if auto-fallback triggers. Slack alert threshold: error_rate > 2%.

DevOps: Important: routing-aware cohorts — ensure `ff_cohort` excludes test bots and api-internal agents. Use `--exclude-cohorts test_*` on the toggle CLI.

Lina M: CLI snippets for the runbook:
```
# start region at 1%
/ff toggle fast-path-nn --region eu --pct 1 --exclude-cohorts test_*
# bump to 10% after healthy
/ff toggle fast-path-nn --region eu --pct 10
# emergency rollback to v2 and disable ff
/ff toggle fast-path-nn --pct 0 --pin v2 --reason "auto-rollback or manual"
```

Carlos V: Proposal for pacing: EU: 10m, NA: 20m, APAC: 20m. APAC has historically shown tail issues so give extra soak.

Lina M: Accepted. Update: EU 10m, NA 20m, APAC 20m. Noted that the change window allows manual rollback until 00:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary EU at 1%. Health checks scheduled at +5m and +10m. Posting status here.

Priya S: During canary, please watch request shape: short requests vs long-prompt distribution. If token-cost-rate increases >15% relative to baseline, treat as a signal and hold ramp.

Carlos V: Also add ktv cache warming note — if we see degraded gen latency after 10% bump, consider warming prefix cache via internal replay. Documented in runbook with command.

Lina M: Release notes draft for product/support: "fast-path-nn (v3.1) hotfix: improves generation tail latency and stability under high concurrency. Phased rollout per-region with rollback to v2 if telemetry gates breach. Change window: 23:00-00:30 UTC."

oncall-bot: Canary EU healthy at 5m check. No spike. Proceed with region bump per plan.

DevOps: Confirmed exclusion list respected for EU cohort.

Carlos V: Proceeding to NA 1% in 3m. I'll monitor and call for pause if anything odd.

(End of thread)
